title: Edit Distance
hints: Define dp[i][j] as the distance between the first i characters of word1 and the first j characters of word2. What are dp[i][0] and dp[0][j]?
If the last characters match, dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]; otherwise 1 + min(dp[i-1][j] (delete), dp[i][j-1] (insert), dp[i-1][j-1] (replace)).
Each row needs only the previous row, so two rows (or one row plus a saved diagonal value) give O(min(m, n)) space when you iterate over the longer string.
